title: Seat lesson 1: the driver
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/osa_ak.json: power_up, pto_on_line) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/osa_ak_crew.json), with their sources
notes: The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off. The commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace.

steps.title: The driver's seat
lines: You are the driver-mechanic (механик-водитель): seat 4 of the Osa 21, front left, at the steering wheel.

You drive the vehicle. And you are the crew's power station: the gas-turbine unit that powers every radar, computer and drive, and the engine's generator at the halt. Nothing in the Osa works until you have done your part.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: First your шлемофон: put it on and plug its cord into your Р-124 box.
Without it you hear only the cabin, and over the engine little of it. Your ПВ box can also put you on the left R-123M.
steps.why: The Osa's crew work in their headsets: the turbine and the fans drown a voice in the cabin (r124_refs; voenizdat_osa_1991).
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: The power-supply panel ПУ-303
lines: To your left, by the dashboard: the power-supply panel. Its ГТА switch starts the gas-turbine power unit (9И120); the generator switch puts the engine's power take-off generator on line. A lamp beside each lights when it runs.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Your dashboard
lines: In front of you: the АРРЕТИР. button, which erects the gyro vertical at start-up, and your intercom box (Р-124), on which you hear the crew and they hear you.

steps.title: The left radio, R-123M
lines: Beside you, on the left: the left R-123M radio set. It is already on. The commander listens to the battery's command post on it, so you keep it working.

steps.title: Drive forward 40 m
lines: W drives forward, S backwards, A and D steer, Space brakes. The Osa only turns while it moves, like any wheeled vehicle.
Drive about 40 m forward, out of the hide.
steps.hint: L: look ahead.   W: forward (hold it).   A / D: steer.   Space: brake.   F2 watches from outside, F1 brings you back.

steps.title: Stop
lines: Brake to a halt: Space, until the vehicle stands still.
steps.why: Much of the Osa works only at a halt: the engine's generator, the turret's drives, the orientation. Driving off with the turret unlocked faults it.

steps.title: Report it: «Стою!»
lines: Tell the crew you have stopped: open your reports with Caps Lock and pick «Стою!» (Halted!).
steps.why: Nobody in the back can see out: the crew only knows the vehicle has halted because you say so.
steps.hint: Caps Lock: your reports; 0 says the green line (or its sector, then its number).

steps.title: The commander: «К бою!»
lines: «К бою!» (Action stations!) brings the whole crew to readiness. Your part comes first: the power.
Listen: the crew acknowledges on the intercom, «Есть!».

steps.title: Start the turbine: ГТА on
lines: On the ПУ-303 panel: flip ГТА up, on.
steps.why: The gas-turbine unit makes the 220 V 400 Hz power every radar, computer and drive in the Osa runs on. The operator is waiting for it to switch the equipment on.

steps.title: The turbine spins up
lines: It takes about a minute for the turbine to come up to speed and give power. The lesson runs time faster while you wait.
steps.wait_text: the turbine to give power (about a minute)

steps.title: Report it: «Питание подано!»
lines: Tell the crew the power is on: Caps Lock, then «Питание подано!» (Power on!). The operator switches the equipment on when he hears it.
steps.hint: Caps Lock: your reports; 0 says the green line (or its sector, then its number).

steps.title: Erect the gyro: АРРЕТИР.
lines: Press АРРЕТИР. on your dashboard.
steps.why: It frees the gyro vertical to erect itself: the level the antennas are stabilised on and the reference the vehicle is oriented by. It takes 40 s, and the deputy commander can't orient the vehicle until it has.

steps.title: The commander: «Генератор на линию!»
lines: «Генератор на линию!» (Generator on line!): at the halt the engine's power take-off generator goes on line as a second source of power beside the turbine.

steps.title: Generator on line
lines: On the ПУ-303 panel: flip the generator switch up, on.
steps.why: The engine-driven generator works only while the vehicle stands still; take it off line before you drive.

steps.title: The gyro erects
lines: The gyro takes 40 s to erect. Then the deputy commander orients the vehicle on it: his work waits on yours. This is how the crew depends on each other.

steps.title: The crew comes to readiness
lines: Your part of К бою is done. Now the others: the operator switches the equipment on and unlocks the turret, the senior operator brings up the search radar, the deputy commander orients the vehicle. Listen to them on the intercom.
F1 or Tab: visit their seats and watch them work. Come back to yours with F1.
steps.wait_text: the search radar to come up («Готов СОЦ!»)

steps.title: A target
lines: A practice drone is flying at you from the north-west. In the fight you stay at your seat, ready to move off the moment the commander orders it. Watch your crew take it on.

steps.title: Search
lines: The senior operator searches with the radar and calls the contact: «Цель, азимут …, дальность …!»
steps.wait_text: the senior operator to find the target

steps.title: «Цель — взять!»
lines: The commander orders it taken; the senior operator, the deputy commander and the operator put the tracking radar on it and capture it: «Захват!»

steps.title: «Приготовиться к пуску!»
lines: The deputy commander prepares the missiles and puts the launch key in.

steps.title: Into the zone
lines: Wait for «Цель в зоне!»: the drone inside the missiles' reach.
steps.wait_text: the target to come into the firing zone

steps.title: «Пуск разрешаю!»
lines: Launch permitted. Press F6 to follow the missile, F1 to come back.

steps.title: Missile away
lines: The missile flies on the tracking radar's commands.
steps.wait_text: the missile to reach the drone

steps.title: The driver's part: done
lines: That is the driver's part of the drill: drive and halt, report it, start the turbine and report the power, erect the gyro, and put the generator on line at the halt.
Practise it without the highlights: the Missions group's «Osa: crew practice, one target», starting in the driver's seat, with H set to hint. Or the next lesson: the operator.
Esc: the menu.
